intro: Oil provides almost all of Kuwait's export earnings and government income.

chapters.title: Oil wealth
text: Kuwait has some of the world's largest oil reserves. In 1953 it created the first sovereign wealth fund, which invests for future generations.

chapters.title: Jobs
text: Most Kuwaiti citizens work for the government, while foreign workers fill most private-sector jobs.

keyTerms.meaning: A national savings fund that invests abroad.

cardGroups.title: Made in Kuwait
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Kuwait makes and sells to the world.
